outcome: Security hardening is now a recorded canonical operating decision rather than an implicit backlog. Six known risks (Coolify plain-HTTP management surface, root desktop exposure, two unidentified public ports, n8n lacking off-host backup, stale ERP exposure premise) are registered as RISKS, explicitly not as work items. The fail-closed database backup chain is recorded as a control to preserve, with an explicit prohibition on provisioning the database or relaxing the preflight to silence it. A future execution that opportunistically fixes one of these is violating the decision.
next_action: None in this stream. The dedicated security mission runs the recorded sequence: FULL SECURITY RECON -> THREAT MODEL -> EXPOSURE INVENTORY -> AUTHORIZATION REVIEW -> NETWORK REVIEW -> DATA/SECRET REVIEW -> BACKUP/RECOVERY REVIEW -> HARDENING -> PENETRATION-STYLE VALIDATION -> REGRESSION TEST -> FINAL SECURITY AUDIT -> GITHUB EXECUTION REPORT.
